name: io.github.tonyyang0504/pinterest-ads-mcp
description: Pinterest Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Eve

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (starts with `pinr`) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, ads:read and ads:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps the rotated token in memory, and when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set it saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600) and prefers it over this variable on the next start.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ad account id (digits) that update_budget and pause_resume PATCH (PATCH /v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns); those verbs take only a campaign id.
